newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal cereals output seen down 35 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Portugal cereals output seen down 35 pct in 1997.

text.p: Portugal's total cereals production is expected to fall by some 35 percent in 1997 compared with 1996 due to a shortage of rain and high temperatures earlier this year, an Agriculture Ministry spokesman said.
He put wheat output at 303,000 tonnes in 1997, compared with 405,000 in 1996, barley at 39,000 tonnes (69,000 in 1996), oats 42,000 (60,000) and rye 38,000 (53,000).
Wheat area was put at 260,000 hectares in 1997 (237,000 in 1996), barley at 43,000 (45,000), oats 77,000 (70,000) and rye 58,000 hectares (60,000).
He said a lack of rainfall in February and March and high temperatures had reduced cereals production.
